causal_graphs.family_mapping: E. coli K-12 YbjQ P0A8C1, sequence version 1, equals NP_415387.1 and AAC73953.1; 107 aa with PF01906 at 1-105. b0866/JW0850 reference identity is not independent sequencing of the historical assay clone. YbjQ is distinct from YjbQ/b4056/PF01894.
causal_graphs.limitations: Normalized double-mutant colony growth is compared with multiplicative expected fitness from the single mutants, not WT or the addition of one deletion. Positive scores are not WT rescue or faster absolute growth. All ten donors are non-essential and labeled This Study in Table S1; Table S16 verifies their Hfr Cavalli deletion::Cm context. Raw colony images, row-specific dispersion, exact clone sequences and allele-specific rescue were not inspected. Marker, polar and secondary-mutation effects remain alternatives; no gene-to-gene interaction mechanism, heavy-metal binding or Fe-S chemistry is inferred.

nodes.label: Normalized colony growth relative to the multiplicative expectation

evidence.explanation: All ten exact YbjQ recipient rows are retained with scores and donor context; repeated colony measurements do not exclude every marker, polar or secondary-mutation effect.

Indexed section 2.6/Figure 19 suggests a YbjQ deletion/retron-induction phenotype, but PDF access returned challenge HTML. The figure and complete controls were not inspected, so no observed edge is derived from the snippet.

discussions.notes: Seek raw normalized fitness, independent alleles, complementation and exact Keio-derived clones. Retrieve the retron thesis figure and assess the published supplements; the related Bobonis2022 main HTML has no YbjQ occurrence, not proof that all supplementary data lack it. Most of the 9784 frozen members remain unassessed. Keep IN_PROGRESS and preserve family versus protein versus domain scope.
discussions.prompt: Validate YbjQ joint-genotype phenotypes and recover the retron-screen primary context.
discussions.rationale: Ten indirect effects preserve a multiplicative single-mutant comparator. These are not a direct molecular network or an isolated YbjQ mechanism.

evidence.explanation: Table 1 includes YbjQ/b0866, but its fragment boundaries and clone-specific insert-dependence controls were not recovered. Selected lambda-repressor fusions can reflect indirect association or false positives; native pentamer stoichiometry was not measured by this assay.
Page 3, poster 35 reports predictions, expression/purification and ongoing metal-binding assays, not a finished metal-binding result with verified member and construct mapping.

discussions.notes: Recover the original fusion clone and controls, inspect member-specific binding/stoichiometry data and map deposited constructs to reference sequences. Do not infer a causal conformational transition from different static structures. Keep YbjQ/b0866 distinct from YjbQ/b4056/PF01894; the Leptospirillum and Sodalis thiamine nomenclature discrepancies need sequence-based resolution before transfer.
discussions.prompt: Resolve biochemical function and exact self-association constructs without promoting predictions to mechanisms.
discussions.rationale: A structural metal-binding label, static pentamers, neighborhood associations and a fusion selection do not establish a native YbjQ metal-binding or assembly mechanism.

evidence.explanation: Figure 1D reports MS co-purification. The author response confirms removal of uncomplemented Rv1762c mutant data with an unresolved encapsulation link. Supplement sheet TnSeq H2O2 low pH, row 1802 (RVBD_1762c), gives log2 FC +0.52, p=0.3979 and adjusted p=1; it is not an observed increase edge.
H37Rv O06797 is 262 aa, equal to NP_216278.1 and CCP44528.1, with partial PF01906 provider matches at 65-123 and 170-244. Whole-protein annotation is not domain-specific functional proof.

discussions.notes: Final Figure 2F is Cfp29 complementation, not Rv1762c. Nichols2020 thesis Figure 3.5F was not inspected and is not independent replication. Seek Rv1762c-specific primary controls and direct cargo/function evidence; preserve assay-specific nonsignificance without claiming no effect in every condition. Do not transfer DyP/Cfp29 effects to this protein or to all PF01906 members.
discussions.prompt: Retain the Rv1762c revision and nonsignificant pooled result before adding an oxidative-protection mechanism.
discussions.rationale: Co-purification is not direct encapsulation. An individual-mutant result was removed during review, and the published pooled Tn-seq result is not significant.
